purpose: The record the section How the entries are ordered of docs/intended-divergences.md links from its sentence on the 1000 Genomes high-coverage chromosome 21 dataset, which is not one of the cuts: how many of its records are records of the gnomAD v4.1 chromosome 21 cut.

dataset.name: 1000 Genomes high-coverage chromosome 21, GRCh38, sites only
dataset.identified_by: cell s06 of the n20 parallel-clones record of this directory, whose bytes and etag are these bytes and md5

cut.name: gnomAD v4.1 chromosome 21, GRCh38
cut.identified_by: cell s04 of the same record, whose bytes are these

commands.count: awk -F'\t' 'FNR == 1 { file++ } /^#/ { next } file == 1 { n++; a[$2 FS $4 FS $5]++; next } { m++; k = $2 FS $4 FS $5; if (k in a) { hit += a[k]; delete a[k] } } END { print n, hit, n - hit, m }' <(zcat 1kg_highcov_chr21.canonical.vcf.gz | cut -f1-5) <(zcat gnomad_genomes_v4.1_chr21.canonical.vcf.gz | cut -f1-5)
commands.note: a record of the dataset is a record of the cut when a record of the cut carries the same POS, REF and ALT, VCF columns 2, 4 and 5 compared as written; both files hold chromosome 21 alone, under the name 21, and neither holds a multi-allelic record; the command prints the four counts in the order below
